The runtime evidence uses discovered repositories; the empty and no-results states are component-tested.

Only mutation controls disable during requests; their behavior is component-tested.

excludedStates.reason: The initial aggregate scan is asynchronous; loading is covered by the Repo Operations view test and the browser adapter captures the settled surface.
The evidence runner uses the canonical catalog inventory; empty and no-results behavior is covered by the view tests.
The browser runner does not inject API failures; the view test covers the full error state.
Branch cleanup remains disabled and global PR handling is intentionally absent; safe sync and repository-scoped OpenCode controls are captured on the default surface.
Focus-visible behavior is covered by shared controls and the view test.

Empty is covered by the repositories view when no repos are registered.
Workspace errors surface through the repositories error handling.
Workspace has no disabled mode.
Focus state is a CSS concern covered by component-level testing.
